frame.objective: Determine if Moldex-Metric should target consumers directly, and if so, which consumer segments, value proposition, and key investigations before investment.
alternatives: Do not enter the consumer market (no direct sales).
Target existing workplace clients for direct sales.
Target specific consumer segments (e.g., DIYers, hobbyists) with a value proposition emphasizing convenience or customization.
Target niche markets (e.g., audiophiles, outdoor enthusiasts) with a value proposition emphasizing performance or style.

searches: why people do not wear earplugs at music events
trial of earplugs at music events
Hearing protection behaviors among Gen Z, barriers to adoption, and effectiveness of direct-to-consumer hearing protecti

T1.claim: Moldex-Metric should target Gen Z directly with a value proposition emphasizing convenience and social acceptance, as they are less likely to use hearing protection due to discomfort and social stigma.
T1.why_behaviour_changes: Gen Z may adopt hearing protection if it is designed to be comfortable and stylish, reducing the stigma associated with wearing earplugs.
T1.how_value_is_captured: Increased sales of hearing protection products, premium pricing for stylish and comfortable designs.
assumptions: Gen Z is willing to adopt hearing protection if it is designed to be comfortable and stylish.
The stigma associated with wearing earplugs is a significant barrier to adoption.
predictions: Gen Z will be more likely to adopt hearing protection if it is designed to be comfortable and stylish.
Moldex-Metric will capture premium value by targeting Gen Z with a value proposition emphasizing convenience and social acceptance.

T2.claim: Moldex-Metric should target Gen Z with a value proposition emphasizing aesthetics and social acceptance, as musicians and young adults prioritize appearance and style in hearing protection.
T2.why_behaviour_changes: Gen Z will prefer hearing protection that aligns with their fashion sense and social status, rather than functional features.
T2.how_value_is_captured: Increased sales of stylish hearing protection products, premium pricing for trendy designs.
assumptions: Gen Z values aesthetics and style in hearing protection.
Musicians and young adults are influential in shaping fashion trends.
predictions: Gen Z will prioritize stylish hearing protection over functional features.
Moldex-Metric will capture premium value by targeting Gen Z with a value proposition emphasizing aesthetics.

T3.claim: Moldex-Metric should target workplace clients with a value proposition emphasizing safety and cost-effectiveness, as they are likely to invest in hearing protection for their employees.
T3.why_behaviour_changes: Workplaces will adopt hearing protection if it is cost-effective and ensures employee safety.
T3.how_value_is_captured: Increased sales of hearing protection products to workplaces, long-term contracts.
assumptions: Workplaces prioritize employee safety and cost-effectiveness.
Moldex-Metric can offer competitive pricing and reliable products.
predictions: Workplaces will adopt hearing protection if it is cost-effective and ensures employee safety.
Moldex-Metric will capture value through long-term contracts with workplaces.

T4.claim: Moldex-Metric should target Gen Z with a value proposition emphasizing convenience and ease of use, as they may be less likely to adopt hearing protection due to discomfort or complexity.
T4.why_behaviour_changes: Gen Z will adopt hearing protection if it is easy to use and convenient, reducing the perceived effort.
T4.how_value_is_captured: Increased sales of hearing protection products, premium pricing for user-friendly designs.
assumptions: Gen Z prioritizes convenience and ease of use.
Complexity is a significant barrier to adopting hearing protection.
predictions: Gen Z will adopt hearing protection if it is easy to use and convenient.
Moldex-Metric will capture premium value by targeting Gen Z with a value proposition emphasizing convenience.

T5.claim: Moldex-Metric should target workplace clients with a value proposition emphasizing durability and reliability, as they are likely to invest in hearing protection for their employees.
T5.why_behaviour_changes: Workplaces will adopt hearing protection if it is durable and reliable, ensuring long-term use.
T5.how_value_is_captured: Increased sales of hearing protection products to workplaces, long-term contracts.
assumptions: Moldex-Metric can offer high-quality, durable products.
predictions: Workplaces will adopt hearing protection if it is durable and reliable.
Moldex-Metric will capture value through long-term contracts with workplaces.
